title: #1028 resolved: 27 spaces mapped to 10 SCALES, 7 zero-producer scales named
body: Producers found live: learning_grpo.py emits rate_01 (success_rate) and millis (avg_duration); queens.py rainbow emits rate_01 (red team) and count (gray/black/yellow/white). Zero-producer scales: boolean (GraphSAGE/GAT masks, SPRT/canary verdicts, verification gates), fitness_points (info/alert/total fitness, ESPO/DEPO/pareto/Thompson/CMA/MCTS), zscore (6 advantage estimators, CISPO/DPPO/SPOT, QD z/escape), loss (8 preference losses), margin (salt-min, HOF, SPRT, bounded-margin, e-process), probability (PU-AUC, calibration, epistemic beliefs), severity_payoff (severity x action table). Mapping target guarded by tests/test_reward_scales.py registry pin.
